I got rejected from 47 jobs.

Then I realized something.

It's not about the resume. It's about the story.

Here's what nobody tells you:
✅ Consistency beats talent
✅ Your network is your net worth
✅ Growth happens outside your comfort zone

Let that sink in.

Agree? ♻️ Repost to help someone in your network.

In today's fast-paced digital landscape, leadership isn't about having all the answers.

It's about asking the right questions.

The best leaders I know:
👉 Listen more than they speak
👉 Empower their teams
👉 Embrace failure as a learning opportunity

What's one leadership lesson that changed your journey? Drop it below 👇

#Leadership #Growth #Mindset #Success #Motivation

AI won't replace you.

A person using AI will.

Most people don't realize this, but the secret to success isn't working harder. It's working smarter. Delve into your why, unlock your potential, and the results will follow. Game-changer.

We shipped the Postgres 17 upgrade for our billing cluster last Tuesday. Two surprises: logical replication slots had to be recreated because of the pg_upgrade path we picked, and one of our reporting queries got 3x slower until we re-ran ANALYZE on the invoices table. Total downtime was 11 minutes. Writing up the runbook this week if anyone on a similar setup wants it.

Our team in Pune is hiring two backend engineers (Go, 3-6 yrs). The work is mostly on the payments reconciliation service — lots of messy bank file formats and idempotency problems. Salary band is posted in the listing. DM me or apply via the link in comments.
spent 4 hours debugging a flaky test that turned out to be a timezone issue because CI runs in UTC and my laptop is in IST. the test only failed between 18:30 and 00:00 local time. I am tired

Read the new FOMC minutes. The interesting bit is paragraph 14: two members wanted to slow QT runoff to $15B/month for Treasuries, not the $25B the market had priced. Doesn't change the path for October but worth watching.
